title: Implement JSONL archive export

Archived tasks have their status updated to 'archived' in the main storage

Unit tests verify export, status update, and index maintenance

title: Implement archive CLI command
description: Replace the placeholder archive command in cmd/devloop/main.go with a fully implemented command in internal/commands/archive.go. Support --wave N flag to archive a specific wave and --auto flag to automatically archive all fully completed waves. Wire the command to the archiver package. Display results including number of tasks archived and output file paths.
acceptance_criteria: devloop archive --wave N archives the specified wave's completed tasks
devloop archive --auto detects and archives all fully completed waves
Command displays summary of archived tasks and output paths
Command returns appropriate errors for invalid wave numbers or no completed tasks
Integration test verifies end-to-end archive workflow

title: Design CLI visual system with lipgloss

Replace fatih/color usage with lipgloss equivalents. Define themed styles that respect NO_COLOR and TERM environment variables. This is the foundation for all subsequent UI improvements.
acceptance_criteria: lipgloss is added to go.mod and internal/ui/styles.go defines the design system
Styles cover: headings, success/error/warning/info messages, labels, tables, borders
NO_COLOR environment variable is respected (disables styling)
Helper functions Success(), Error(), Warning(), Info(), Section() are exported
Unit tests verify styled output and NO_COLOR behavior
